parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the IPsec-VPN connection is created.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: VpnConnectionId
parameters.description: The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-vpn-connection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-connection-id vco-bp1bbi27hojx80nck0000 --region cn-hangzhou
